declarations.type:
∀ {grantActive : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.RecoveryGrant → Prop}
  {request : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.RecoveryRequest}
  {targetKey : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationKey.RetryPublicationKey},
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.Authorized grantActive request targetKey →
    grantActive request.grant ∧
      request.presentedKey = targetKey ∧
        request.grant.workspaceIdentity = targetKey.workspaceIdentity ∧
          request.grant.ledgerGeneration = targetKey.ledgerGeneration ∧
            request.grant.contractVersion = targetKey.contractVersion ∧
              request.grant.tenantScope = targetKey.tenantScope ∧ request.grant.retryIdentity = targetKey.retryIdentity
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.authorization_preserves_key_and_all_scope_dimensions

declarations.type:
∀ {Certificate : Type u} (grantActive : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.RecoveryGrant → Prop)
  [inst : DecidablePred grantActive]
  (ledger :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublicationLedger
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationKey.RetryPublicationKey Certificate)
  (request : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.RecoveryRequest)
  (targetKey : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationKey.RetryPublicationKey),
  ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.Authorized grantActive request targetKey →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.authorizedRecover grantActive ledger request targetKey =
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.RecoveryOutcome.denied
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.unauthorized_request_is_denied_before_winner_lookup

declarations.type:
∀ {Certificate : Type u} (grantActive : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.RecoveryGrant → Prop)
  [inst : DecidablePred grantActive]
  (ledger :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublicationLedger
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationKey.RetryPublicationKey Certificate)
  (request : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.RecoveryRequest)
  (targetKey : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationKey.RetryPublicationKey) (winner : Certificate),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.Authorized grantActive request targetKey →
    ledger targetKey = some winner →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.authorizedRecover grantActive ledger request targetKey =
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.RecoveryOutcome.released winner
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryWinnerAuthorization.authorized_request_recovers_existing_winner
